note: Release: Diamond (USA) from the name the uploader gave it ("1015 - Pokemon Diamond (US).SAV"). 99% of the file is 0xFF, with fragments of a Diamond/Pearl save in it (the trainer name "Red" at 0x64). Each of the four blocks ends in a CRC-16 that matches its data, but the rest of every block footer (save count, size, magic) is 0xFF. Every core starts a new game. The library's image of this game code is the Pokemon - Diamond Version (Europe) (Rev 5) release; the save was run in it, since both releases share the game code.
